ar.title: أسياخ فاكهة قوس قزح
ar.intro:
اشبك الفاكهة في أعواد بألوان قوس قزح كلها.

اغمسها في زبادي بالعسل.

steps.n2: شخص كبير يقشّر الكيوي ويقطع الفاكهة الكبيرة مكعبات.
steps.n4: اشبك الفاكهة في العود بترتيب قوس قزح: أحمر، برتقالي، أصفر، أخضر، أزرق، بنفسجي.

en.title: Rainbow Fruit Kebabs
en.intro:
Thread fruit onto sticks in every colour of the rainbow.

Dip them in yogurt mixed with a little honey.

steps.n1: Wash all the fruit and dry it.
steps.n2: A grown-up peels the kiwi and cuts the big fruit into chunks.
steps.n3: Peel the mandarins and pull them into pieces.
steps.n4: Push the fruit onto a stick in rainbow order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple.
steps.n5: Hold the stick carefully: the tip is pointy!

legacySteps: Wash all the fruit and dry it.
A grown-up peels the kiwi and cuts the big fruit into chunks.
Peel the mandarins and pull them into pieces.
Push the fruit onto a stick in rainbow order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple.
Hold the stick carefully: the tip is pointy!
